title: CODEOWNERS names an owning group for every policy path, and a code push that changes policy leaves its merge to a code owner
goal: The integration repository's .gitlab/CODEOWNERS has a section owning policy/kbjobs/ and one per group directory under policy/kbjobs/groups/ naming that GitLab group; check.py exits 1 naming each policy/ file no CODEOWNERS line covers; kg_sync.push_options(target, paths) leaves out merge_request.auto_merge when a path is under policy/, so a code owner merges the request (GitLab enforces the approval on a protected branch with Require Code Owner approval, Premium or Ultimate); other code pushes keep auto-merge

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kg_sync
a=kg_sync.push_options("main",["policy/kbjobs/groups/corp/ops/data.json"]); b=kg_sync.push_options("main",["_tools/coord.py"])
assert "merge_request.auto_merge" not in a and "merge_request.create" in a and "merge_request.auto_merge" in b, (a,b)

import sys,os,tempfile,subprocess
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); w=os.path.join(d,"w"); subprocess.run(["git","clone","-q","--local",".",w],check=True)
p=os.path.join(w,"policy","kbjobs","groups","nosuch","grp"); os.makedirs(p); open(os.path.join(p,"data.json"),"w").write("{}")
subprocess.run(["git","add","-A"],cwd=w,check=True)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/check.py"],cwd=w,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=600)
assert r.returncode==1 and "policy/kbjobs/groups/nosuch/grp/data.json" in r.stdout+r.stderr and "CODEOWNERS" in r.stdout+r.stderr, r.stdout[-2000:]
